title: Portal Guardian
description: A woman in pink and purple fantasy armor kneels on a checkered stone floor, drawing a glowing magical sigil. Behind her stands a blue demonic guardian with horns and armor in a stone archway, while a massive swirling cosmic portal with runes dominates the starry nebula sky above a gothic cathedral.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene featuring a woman in ornate pink and purple armor kneeling on a checkered stone courtyard, drawing a glowing purple sigil on the ground. To her right, a muscular blue demon with horns and pink armor stands guard inside a stone archway. In the background, a towering gothic cathedral with green windows rises beneath a vibrant cosmic nebula sky filled with stars and a massive swirling white magical portal with glowing runes. Epic composition, cinematic lighting.
